name: Figma
what_it_is: A collaborative interface design tool running in the browser, with multiplayer editing, components and variants, design tokens, prototyping, and inspection panels that expose measurements and values to developers.
why_it_matters: Figma is included deliberately, because it is exactly the kind of tool a repository-based view of the ecosystem cannot see — it appears in no manifest, yet it is where most frontend work originates. Fluency in reading a Figma file, not just receiving screenshots, is a real and unevenly distributed frontend skill.
suitable_for: Any team where design and engineering hand off work
Extracting spacing, colour and type values accurately
Keeping design tokens aligned with implemented components
not_suitable_for: Teams with no design function, where it adds process without benefit
Environments where browser-based SaaS is not permitted
